# EdgeRock

> EdgeRock is Rock Matrix's family of multimodal reasoning models with constant-size persistent history. EdgeRock-4B is its first open-source 4B model, supporting text and image reasoning through recurrent state, sliding-window attention, and Rock Memory Anchors (RMA).

A memory anchor is a learned key–value record retrieved after its source information leaves the local attention window. RMA stores these records in a fixed-capacity bank. Persistent history is O(1) in sequence length; total GPU allocation also includes weights, buffers, and workspace and scales with concurrency.

## Key results

- [Reasoning benchmarks](https://github.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock#strong-reasoning-at-constant-memory): EdgeRock-4B averages 82.9% pass@1 on AIME 2024–2026, versus 18.8% for RWKV-7 G1j in the 14B class, the strongest evaluated bounded-state baseline on AIME.
- [KV cache and GPU memory](https://github.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock#constant-history-and-gpu-memory): EdgeRock-4B uses 72 MiB attention KV per sequence, 99.1% less than Qwen3.5-4B at 256K context with BF16 KV. Batch-runtime persistent history, including FP16 recurrent-state storage, is 97.76 MiB per sequence.
- [Best-batch throughput](https://github.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock#best-batch-output-throughput): EdgeRock-4B delivers 6.42× Qwen3.5-4B's end-to-end output tokens/s at 32K input + 32K output on one Hopper 80GB GPU, using each model's best measured batch. Output tokens alone form the numerator; elapsed time includes prefill. Weights/KV are BF16, GDN updates use FP32, and state storage is FP32 at batch size 1 or FP16 for larger batches, with ordinary autoregressive decoding.

## Model and results

- [简体中文](https://github.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock/blob/main/README_zh-CN.md): 中文介绍、性能结果与使用方式。

- [Model overview and evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock/main/README.md): all eight report figures and complete comparison tables, plus model definitions and FAQ. Bounded-state capability, compact-model comparisons, and source-model retention appear separately.
- [EdgeRock-4B questions and answers](https://github.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock#frequently-asked-questions): model identity, O(1) history memory, memory anchors, and inference without quantization or speculative decoding.
- [Evaluation results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock/main/docs/results.md): text and image benchmarks, comparison groups, and evaluation protocol.
- [Inference runtime and results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock/main/docs/runtime.md): BF16 execution, FP32 GDN updates, FP16 batch-state storage, constant history, throughput definitions, and measured workloads.
- [Model weights on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock): official EdgeRock-4B checkpoint and model card.
- [Model weights on ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/rockmatrix/EdgeRock): EdgeRock model distribution.

- [中文技术报告](https://github.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock/blob/main/docs/report/EdgeRock_Technical_Report_zh-CN.pdf): 完整中文版技术报告。

- [arXiv:2610.10118](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10118): paper record and citation identifier.
- [Inference guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock/main/USAGE.md): installation, generation, serving, and evaluation commands.
- [Technical report](https://github.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock/blob/main/docs/report/EdgeRock_Technical_Report.pdf): full English report.
- [Citation metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock/main/CITATION.cff): report authors and preferred citation.
- [Code license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock/main/LICENSE): Apache-2.0 terms for runtime code.
- [Model license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rockmatrix-ai/EdgeRock/main/MODEL_LICENSE): terms governing the model weights.
